File: README.md

In the 'Running locally' section, step 2 (which says a MinIO container is the quickest option) should add a line noting that S3_ENDPOINT (e.g. http://localhost:9000) must be set for MinIO and that the bucket must be created manually in the MinIO console before uploading.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
README.md step 2 only says 'Start PostgreSQL and an S3-compatible store. A MinIO container is the quickest option for the bucket.' with no mention of S3_ENDPOINT, while docs/CONFIG.md documents S3_ENDPOINT as the setting needed for MinIO-style endpoints; the reporter's error (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND ...amazonaws.com) matches the default AWS endpoint being used because S3_ENDPOINT was never set, as confirmed by the maintainer's comment.
